title: Tura benchmark common definitions
description: Shared value objects used by benchmark source, normalized contract, and website data schemas.

nonEmptyString.description: A non-empty UTF-8 string. Identifiers and required human-readable labels use this type.

nullableString.description: A string when the source recorded a value; null when the value is genuinely unavailable.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC or with an explicit offset. Use null instead of a fabricated time.

nonNegativeInteger.description: A count that cannot be negative.

nonNegativeNumber.description: A measured numeric value that cannot be negative.

runStatus.description: Final evaluated run state. Unknown or unevaluated runs must not be published as completed benchmark runs.

executionStatus.description: Lifecycle state of one command or tool call. unknown is allowed only for reconstructed historical calls whose completion event is absent; it must not be displayed as a duration or harness result.

tokenUsage.description: Token accounting for one trustworthy aggregation boundary. Omit this object when per-round usage cannot be reconstructed reliably.

inputTokens.description: All input tokens charged or reported for this boundary, including cached input when the provider reports it as part of input.

cacheInputTokens.description: Input tokens served from provider cache. This is a subset of inputTokens unless the provider explicitly documents otherwise.

outputTokens.description: All generated output tokens. For OpenAI models this normally already includes reasoning tokens.

reasoningTokens.description: Reasoning-token subset reported by the provider. Do not add it to outputTokens when computing totalTokens.

totalTokens.description: Canonical total, normally inputTokens + outputTokens. It must not double-count cached or reasoning subsets.

nullableTokenUsage.description: Per-round compatibility usage. Null values explicitly mean the source cannot reliably attribute usage to this round.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens or null when unreconstructable.

codeLocation.description: Stable pointer to source or harness code.

repository.description: GitHub owner/repository name or repository URL.

commit.description: Commit SHA or stable ref used by the run. Null means the source did not record one.

path.description: Repository-relative path. Never store a machine-specific absolute path here.

symbol.description: Function, test, assertion group, or logical harness symbol inside the file.

localPath.description: Optional local development path. Website code must not depend on this value.

agentRuntime.description: Installed CLI/runtime release that executed the agent, distinct from the model version.

packageName.description: Published package or executable family, for example @openai/codex or tura.

agentApplicationVersion.description: Version printed by the actual CLI binary used for the run.

versionSource.description: Field, command, or artifact from which the version was obtained.

agentMetadata.description: Public agent identity shared by all runs with the same provider, mode, model, and effort.

id.description: Canonical public ID: {agent-base}-{model}-{effort}. Internal names such as codex-main are not valid public IDs.

name.description: Human-readable label shown by the website.

provider.description: Agent/CLI provider family, not necessarily the upstream LLM API provider.

mode.description: Execution profile such as cli, direct, or balanced.

model.description: Normalized model ID, for example gpt-5.5. It must reflect the real source run.

effort.description: Normalized reasoning effort used by the run, for example medium or high.

version.description: Installed agent application version shown in metadata.

systemMetadata.description: Host and CLI information common to the run.

platform.description: Runtime platform identifier such as win32 or linux.

arch.description: CPU architecture such as x64 or arm64.

cliApplication.description: Executable or package that launched the agent.

environmentMetadata.description: Task execution environment. Language/toolchain versions belong here, not in the agent version.

operatingSystem.description: Operating system used by the task workspace.

runtime.description: Primary project language, decoder, compiler, or runtime.

language.description: Runtime/toolchain family, for example Rust, Python, Node.js, or browser.

projectVersion.description: Version detected from the task repository or runtime command.

browser.description: Browser name/version for browser-based harnesses; null when no browser was involved.

message.description: One complete user, assistant, system, or tool message. Text is never truncated in the normalized source contract.

id.description: Stable message/event ID when supplied by the source.

type.description: Source message subtype, such as agent_message.

format.description: Rendering format, normally markdown or text.

text.description: Complete display text with original paragraph breaks and Markdown.

content.description: Compatibility alias for complete message content.

usage.description: Message-local usage only when the provider reports this exact boundary.

source.description: Artifact or reconstruction stream from which the message came.

command.description: One tool call or shell command with the complete executable input and output.

toolName.description: Public tool name shown in the collapsed command header.

type.description: Tool-call subtype, for example shell_command, apply_patch, or read_file.

isCommandRun.description: True only for Tura command-run events that have an authoritative commandRunStep.

step.description: Display step. For command-run events it must equal the real command run step; otherwise it may be null.

commandRunStep.description: Authoritative Tura command-run step. Null for non-Tura or non-command-run tools.

commandIndex.description: Zero- or one-based source command ordering index retained for traceability.

providerToolCallId.description: Provider-level tool call ID used to join request and response events.

commandLine.description: Complete console command or complete serialized tool input. It is not a workspace path label.

preview.description: First meaningful command line used only for collapsed UI preview.

exitCode.description: Process exit code. Null when the tool does not produce an exit code.

durationMs.description: Measured tool duration in milliseconds. Null when absent; never render as unknown.

receipt.description: Short execution receipt or structured tool result summary.

stdout.description: Complete standard output captured for the command.

stderr.description: Complete standard error captured for the command.

harnessScore.description: Integer harness totals for one run.

total.description: Total evaluated assertions; must equal passed + failed.

ratio.description: passed / total, or 0 when total is 0.

harnessRule.description: Stable task-level scoring rule. Its ID is reused by every run-level harness result.

description.description: What behavior the rule measures and why it matters.

category.description: Logical harness group used for filtering and display.

sourceLocation.description: Task source or reference implementation associated with this rule.

harnessFailure.description: Failure evidence. New writers should emit the structured object; string is retained for normalized legacy SWE-bench assertions.

expected.description: Expected value in a JSON-compatible representation.

actual.description: Actual value in a JSON-compatible representation.

command.description: Harness command that produced the failure.

comparison.description: Comparison operator or semantic comparison description.

raw.description: Raw structured failure payload when available.
